usedFor: Brevo sends your campaigns and Attio keeps the customer records, so “Contact Unsubscribed” runs “Update Record” on the matching contact.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Unsubscribed” in Brevo, then “Update Record” in Attio
bestTemplate.why: An unsubscribe is a status change your sales team should see on the Attio record, not only in Brevo.

watchOut: “Contact Updated” in Brevo fires on every edit, so the same contact can run “Update Record” again.
